segments.text: Some cars ask for space on the road. The Scorpio-N, with 203 horsepower, just takes it.
Pick the diesel four-by-four and 400 Newton-metres turn every pothole into a rounding error.
From near thirteen-and-a-half lakh, the top one adds a twelve-speaker Sony and driver-assist that watches the road for you.
It's the big cousin who shows up uninvited and still runs the whole party. Tap like if that's your energy.
